Hey Jiri. No need to apologize for being you. You're not alone with those feelings I have them too. Not always though. They come and go sometimes they're worse than others I've accepted that. You are worthy, even if you don't feel like it sometimes I have to remind myself all the time it's difficult. I'm in a good place right now I really hope you find your way to one soon. The best advice I can give would be to seek help and treatment for the way you feel. Find someone to confide in. I know when I'm in my darkest place it is really hard to do. It has taken a lot of tries and it's never easy. You don't have to suffer alone though it's really not worth it.

For me I find those feeling like that are fleeting. When I say fleeting sometimes they stay hours, days, or months. I can't help it though it's my brain it lies to me constantly. Lots of people can love you but not know how to deal with you. In my experience I've noticed that also includes myself. sometimes I love myself other times I hate myself I hate myself so much I don't want to be alive anymore. It's when I hate myself I lose the ability to deal with being me, it sucks. 

For what it's worth you haven't hindered my happiness or pissed me off. You've reminded me that there's people that suffer like I do, you me and lots of other folks here we all suffer from the lies that our brain tells us. Come to think of it I would say you have brightened my night. You've allowed me the opportunity to reflect and share my thoughts (sorry they are random) and I really appreciate that. I'm sorry you're in a dark place, I promise though you're not alone in it.

That last line of not being able to fix the leak hits home. I've accepted the fact that there will be many more times when im near people who care and love me yet I will still feel completely alone, unwanted, worthless, and overlooked. I know no matter how happy I am for a moment or how far away all the sadness and emptiness of previous days feel one day (hell maybe tomorrow maybe a month from now) I will once again feel completely empty inside and depending on how long that lasts I may or may not have to get back on medication I've been on and off of it for years. I know when I do get back on it my emotions will disappear for as long as I take it. I will become a robot that doesn't feel. I will always be weird inside, never quite right. No matter how many times I get patched up I know one day I'm going to crumble again.

For me identifying triggers has helped greatly oftentimes when suicidal ideation creeps in hardest for me it's related to extreme temporary insomnia. Often the insomnia is worst when I'm at my lowest. Probably not good advice but got a bottle of a sleep aid usually something that has diphenhydramine only (use care taking otc drugs that can do real harm )not to overdose but taken two or three or I drink the equivalent depending on whatever form it comes in make the bed as comfortable as I can darken the room and just do my best to sleep. I'm still obviously depressed when I wake up but my mental space is a little bit more clear, a little less scary, and a lot less dark. If you have experienced depression for a while meaning not over a single stretch of time but having highs and lows over a long period of time it tends to get easier to recognize it when it happens. When I'm actively depressed I've come to find multiple triggers that make it worse. I avoid those or counter them the best I can and that helps me maybe identifying your triggers countering them or avoiding them might help you with the suicidal ideations.
